newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PM KLAUS SAYS STILL SEES BALANCED 97 BUDGET.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PM KLAUS SAYS STILL SEES BALANCED 97 BUDGET.

text.p: The 1997 Czech state budget should still be balanced at year-end, despite an 8.5 billion crown deficit for the first quarter and lower than planned revenues due to slow economic growth, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said on Wednesday.

Klaus made his comments while announcing 25.5 billion crowns worth of cuts in budget expenditures as part of a package of pro-economic growth measures. The Czech 1997 budget calls for expenditures and revenues to be balanced at 549.1 billion crowns.
